target_customer: Companies launching products who want bloggers to review them, and bloggers who want early review copies
problem: Product PR relied on one to one pitching of journalists; LaunchHear tried to make getting early review copies to bloggers scale.
business_model: Marketplace connecting product makers and bloggers (revenue model not found)
product_category: Blogger outreach and product seeding marketplace

founders.name: Alex Krupp
founders.background_notes: Later ventures per YC page; whether earlier than LaunchHear is unknown.

founders.name: Allan Young
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of LaunchHear and of other ventures.

competitors.name: MyLikes
competitors.what: Paid sponsored likes where users promote advertisers products

competitors.name: BzzAgent
competitors.what: Word of mouth marketing community that sampled products to participants
competitors.traction_then: About 500,000 participants and over 500 programs for 250 plus customers, per its own FTC comments

technical_complexity.rationale: A directory and request workflow between bloggers and companies; standard web development.

defensibility.rationale: Only a two sided list with no exclusive supply; PR agencies and seeding firms could replicate it quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found; the company went inactive.

market_need_then: Bloggers were gaining PR influence in 2009 and 2010 and agencies were building blogger outreach programs, but FTC endorsement rules from 2009 added disclosure friction. Direct demand evidence for LaunchHear was not found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand or community found beyond directory listings.

outcome_analysis: LaunchHear entered YC in Winter 2010 with a two person team and went inactive, but no shutdown date, post-mortem or acquisition is public, so the cause is not public. The business was a thin two sided matching service with little defensibility, which fits a market too small or hard to monetize, yet no source states that.
notes: Cause of shutdown not found. CB Insights lists $20K total raised with YC as investor; seen only in an aggregator so recorded here as unverified, not as a round. Website field is blank and the site was not checked. Founded year is inferred from the batch and is approximate. Completeness pass: the $20K total with Y Combinator as investor rests on a single database (CB Insights), likely the YC deal; the year is the batch year (W10) and not stated by the source.
